ui.exchange_prompt_text.create_a_glide_e:
Create a Glide exchange file ({exchange_suffix}).

Answer only with a JSON object, without any prose before or after it.

Structure
  {{
    "format": "{exchange_format_name}",
    "format_version": {exchange_format_version},
    "mode": "create",
    "generator": {{"type": "ai"}},
    "labels": [{{"key": "label-1", "name": "Release", "color": "flag"}}],
    "folders": [{{"key": "folder-1", "title": "Project", "parent": "folder-0", "folder_kind": "standard", "labels": ["label-1"]}}],
    "lists": [{{"key": "list-1", "title": "Title", "folder": "folder-1", "list_kind": "tasks",
                "description": "What this list is for.", "markdown": "# Title\nNote text", "labels": ["label-1"], "items": [ ... ]}}]
  }}

An item
  {{"type": "task", "title": "Short action", "description": "Goal and result.",
    "importance": 0-3, "due": "YYYY-MM-DD", "due_time": "HH:MM",
    "planned_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "estimated_minutes": 30,
    "repeat": {{"kind": "weekly"}}, "reminder": {{"mode": "relative", "minutes": 15}},
    "labels": ["label-1"], "done": false,
    "checklist": [{{"text": "Step", "done": false}}],
    "children": [ ... ]}}

Meaning of the item types ({arten})
  task     An actionable step with a clear result.
  long     A larger, text-oriented piece of work.
  group    A container for items. Cannot be completed itself, no date.
  heading  Pure structure. No due date, no importance, no done state.

List types ({listenarten})
  tasks    Task list with items (default).
  note     Note: text in markdown or rich_note, optionally items above it.
  page     Page: formatted text in markdown or rich_note.
  drawing  Pixel drawing in drawing or a frame sequence in animation.
  gallery  Gallery: image collection (empty without images).

Folder types ({ordnerarten})
  standard Standard folder for all list types (default).
  library  Book: collects formatted pages and documents.
  journal  Notebook: for journals and notes.

Meaning of the fields
  title        Title of an item, list or folder (at most {container_title_max} characters).
  description  What the task means and which result is expected.
  markdown     Formatted Markdown text for pages or notes (converted to Glide's format automatically).
  folder_kind  Type of the folder: standard, library (book) or journal (notebook).
  repeat       Repeat rule on tasks with due (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, weekdays with days: [0-6], every_n_days with interval: n).
  reminder     Notification: relative (mode "relative" with minutes) or fixed (mode "fixed" with ISO time stamp at).
  children     Real subitems that are completed on their own.
  checklist    Work steps inside an item, without their own dates.
  due          By when something must be finished.
  planned_date When it should be worked on. That is not the same.

Rules
  1. Choose keys ("key") freely, but keep them unique. Do not invent
     internal IDs; Glide assigns them itself on import.
  2. Titles of tasks, lists and folders may be at most {container_title_max2}
     characters long. Longer content belongs in description, markdown or rich_note.
  3. Create at most {max_items} items and at most
     {max_checklist_entries} checklist steps per item.
     Nest at most {max_depth} levels deep.
  4. Use few, reused labels instead of one label per task.
     Labels can be assigned to items, lists and folders.
  5. Always write dates as YYYY-MM-DD and times as HH:MM.
  6. Not every paragraph is a task. Use heading for sections,
     long for explanatory texts and task only where something needs to be done.
  7. File attachments and images (attachments, cover) can be supplied in a ZIP exchange package
     under attachments/ (e.g. {{"file": "attachments/image.png"}}).

Revising existing content (from Glide 3.35, exchange format {version})
  If a context package ({context_suffix}, format "{context_format}") is attached,
  answer with a change proposal instead of new lists:
  {{
    "format": "{exchange_format_name2}",
    "format_version": {version2},
    "mode": "patch",
    "changes": [{{"ref": "r-…", "base": "…", "set": {{"due": "YYYY-MM-DD", "importance": 2}}}}]
  }}
  Copy ref and base unchanged from the package. set only contains fields that
  should change: {join}.

mod.release_notes.v1_0_2.0: Sidebar titles update immediately on language switch without restarting.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_2.1: Page cover images are cropped adaptively without vertical stretching.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_2.2: Pixel drawings as cover appear as a compact corner stamp scrolling with text.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_2.3: Natural day words like “today”, “tomorrow”, “yesterday” are directly recognized in date fields.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_2.4: The footer remains single-row even at smaller window sizes.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_1.0: The new “City Light” showcase presents every feature as a photo journey through seven cities, in English and German.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_1.1: Quick capture understands English words such as “tomorrow”, “next Monday” or “every week”; German words keep working.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_1.2: Open pages show in their header when they were last edited.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_1.3: The exchange format, system labels, templates, the home page and AI output read fully in English.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_0.0: Glide speaks English and German; Ctrl+Shift+L (Mac: Cmd+Shift+L) switches the language without a restart.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_0.1: Windows gets an installer with uninstaller, macOS a DMG image.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_0.2: The AI skill “glide-to-do” can be exported for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Gemini CLI and web assistants.
mod.release_notes.v3_63_0.0: Filled triangles are easier to read in the sidebar and on back/forward arrows.
mod.release_notes.v3_63_0.1: Borderless task actions take on the background of the whole hovered or selected row.
mod.release_notes.v3_63_0.2: “All to tomorrow” moves open task and day reminders to tomorrow at 09:00.
mod.release_notes.v3_63_0.3: The drawing editor offers the display profiles Standard, Extended, Animation and Pixelate images.
mod.release_notes.v3_63_0.4: Table headers align with their content; clicking a column header sorts again.
mod.release_notes.v3_61_0.0: “Lighten the day” explains below the balance why a day is overplanned.
mod.release_notes.v3_61_0.1: Search finds umlauts even in texts that store them decomposed, for example from macOS file names.
mod.release_notes.v3_61_0.2: If the data folder is unreachable, Glide names the path and quits without changing anything.
mod.release_notes.v3_60_0.0: Settings open immediately, even with the “Creative” style and a small font.
mod.release_notes.v3_60_0.1: New app icon and two-colour logo in the window header; its surface follows the theme colour.
mod.release_notes.v3_60_0.2: The sidebar stays reachable down to the drawings, even with several pinned pages.
mod.release_notes.v3_55_1.0: When lightening a day you choose the tasks and the new planned day and confirm with “Reschedule”.
mod.release_notes.v3_55_1.1: JSON Canvas export works again and, like the app backup, suggests a file name with a simple extension.
mod.release_notes.v3_55_0.0: The day balance shows task effort, booked calendar time and remaining capacity.
mod.release_notes.v3_55_0.1: Tasks without an estimate stay visible. The lighten dialog shows which due dates are kept when rescheduling.
mod.release_notes.v3_54_0.0: Show usages lists every use of a task, page, note, list or drawing with a direct jump.
mod.release_notes.v3_54_0.1: Pinboards can be exported as an open JSON Canvas 1.0 file (.canvas) with cards, areas, connections and a loss report.
mod.release_notes.v3_54_0.2: Checkboxes, radio buttons, list boxes and sliders are fully integrated into the Glide design.
mod.release_notes.v3_52_0.0: Font styles: Modern Rubik, Technical DM Mono, Creative DM Serif Display, Classic Charis SIL; saved styles are kept.
mod.release_notes.v3_52_0.1: Font weight and font size can be set separately. Creative and Classic are automatically bolder.
mod.release_notes.v3_52_0.2: Add and other highlights follow the chosen theme colour. Delete stays red and Confirm green.
mod.release_notes.v3_52_0.3: The header logo is slightly larger and sits two pixels further right.
mod.release_notes.v3_52_0.4: DejaVu Sans remains internal for UI symbols that the selectable fonts do not contain.
mod.release_notes.v3_51_0.0: The sidebar plus buttons show their surface on hover and their focus with keyboard use.
mod.release_notes.v3_51_0.1: Sidebar counters have more room to the right edge. Windows menus are flatter and the header icons match the title.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_7.0: Glide combines projects, tasks, day planning, pinboards and pixel drawings as a desktop planner.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_7.1: About Glide shows the product description, the MPL-2.0 licence and the link to the source code.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_7.2: The separate Python edition contains the full licence text and notes on redistribution.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_7.3: The sidebar adapts its row height to the chosen font and keeps its design after a restart.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_6.0: Pages show their title only in the header in the theme colour; below, every view has a subtitle.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_6.1: Title fields count down the remaining characters; overly long attachment names are shortened before saving.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_6.2: The pinboard has a single toolbar row; selection fields show their full text.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_6.3: Backspace in a text field no longer deletes a selected item, and closing areas leaves no gap.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_6.4: Done and open items start at the same edge; What's new shows at most three versions.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_5.0: Buttons shorten long labels with an ellipsis; the full text stays in the tooltip.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_5.1: New and changed task titles are limited to 40 characters, like page, list and folder titles.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_5.2: Notes and drawings group journal actions in the More menu and give more room back to the content.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_5.3: The home page offers a field for global search, templates a search filter of their own.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_5.4: The narrow Today bar and the spacing within sidebar sections are more compact.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_4.0: Books use their full width even with a narrow or hidden sidebar.

mod.release_notes.v3_50_4.2: Yellow hints in dark mode appear consistently in the new brand yellow.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_3.0: Page and drawing tools stay on one line; further actions are available in the respective menu.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_3.1: Task actions are always visible; labels and books use the available width without an empty action reserve.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_3.2: Due dates in tables stay fully readable; input, search and page footer get suitable spacing.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_3.3: The drawing's cell highlight appears with keyboard use and disappears with mouse use.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_2.0: Sidebar and content keep their light or dark theme colour; the chosen background colour lies behind them.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_2.1: Font styles: Modern: Rubik, Technical: Roboto Mono, Creative: Playfair Display and Classic: Fraunces.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_2.2: Playfair Display and Fraunces with a stronger base weight; bold and italic highlights remain available.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_2.3: The header stays stable when switching to Today; the content area gets its intended space.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_0.0: First public state: use tasks, pages, notes, pinboards and the pixel workshop locally; four font styles with Rubik as default.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_0.1: Choose the background colour independently of the design; “Like the window surface” joins the surfaces without material shadows.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_0.2: Full sidebar, header aligned with the content; drag page blocks by the six-dot handle and format them by right-click.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_0.3: Side view: jump to matches and sections, recall recent searches and look up selected text.
mod.release_notes.v3_50_0.4: Choose focus intervals, extend by five minutes and move on to the next task; large data saves faster.
mod.release_notes.v3_49_0.0: Home page: pick a day of the viewed, previous or next week directly from the week.
mod.release_notes.v3_49_0.1: Change due date and effort of selected day tasks together, with one undo step.
mod.release_notes.v3_49_0.2: Side view: copy references, open targets in the main area and link content on purpose.
mod.release_notes.v3_49_0.3: After an unexplained program exit, the data stays protected with the original pre-backup until you release it.
mod.release_notes.v3_49_0.4: Local start and finish logs record operating phases without task content.
mod.release_notes.v3_48_0.0: Home page: switch between days or pick a date and open the matching day plan.
mod.release_notes.v3_48_0.1: Planning, free time and due dates stay separately traceable for the displayed day.
mod.release_notes.v3_48_0.2: Prioritise selected day tasks together and add or remove your own labels.
mod.release_notes.v3_48_0.3: Internal text links in the side view open further content without leaving the main work.
mod.release_notes.v3_48_0.4: Search references and backlinks in the side view and return with the history.
mod.release_notes.v3_47_0.0: Home page: select several day tasks and plan them together or remove the planned day.
mod.release_notes.v3_47_0.1: The selection survives preview pages; Select all covers all open day tasks.
mod.release_notes.v3_47_0.2: Joint planning with capacity preview, unchanged due date and one undo step.
mod.release_notes.v3_47_0.3: Side view: Back and Forward, also with Alt+Arrow, restore search and reading position.
mod.release_notes.v3_47_0.4: History shows visited content with current titles and offers a direct switch.
mod.release_notes.v3_46_0.0: Home page: tick off day tasks directly; the preview shows five genuinely open tasks.
mod.release_notes.v3_46_0.1: More on every day task: schedule with capacity preview, reschedule or remove the planned day.
mod.release_notes.v3_46_0.2: Next task: start focus and planning directly; the day suggestion is available on the home page.
mod.release_notes.v3_46_0.3: Side view: search content, highlight matches and move between them with Enter or Shift+Enter.
mod.release_notes.v3_46_0.4: Jump via sections to headings or task groups while the main work stays open.
mod.release_notes.v3_45_0.0: Compact mode at the top of the View menu; side view and searchable page and block actions.
mod.release_notes.v3_45_0.1: Storage status with separate error messages, Save again and a backup reserve.
mod.release_notes.v3_45_0.2: Backup overview: search files, see sizes, read, compare and restore content selectively.
mod.release_notes.v3_45_0.3: Executable attachments open only after confirmation; Windows image previews handle unusual file names.
mod.release_notes.v3_44_0.0: Redo: Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z, on Windows also Ctrl+Y, takes back an undo.
mod.release_notes.v3_44_0.1: Custom rhythms: several weekdays, nth weekday, end of month, pause and limited count.
mod.release_notes.v3_44_0.2: Saved views with more conditions, as list, table or column board, grouped and sorted.
mod.release_notes.v3_44_0.3: Pages and notes as pinboard cards; unlinked mentions reveal forgotten connections.
mod.release_notes.v3_44_0.4: Export everything as a Markdown folder; five ready-made AI tasks with full preview.
mod.release_notes.v3_43_0.0: Home page: new Gallery images tile, “Customize home” on the left, after “Read” straight to the top.
mod.release_notes.v3_43_0.1: Gismo is always called Gismo and always plays along; if you don't want him, hide his tile.
mod.release_notes.v3_43_0.2: A calmer header with a magnifier for search, without date and “?”; usage hints via the settings.
mod.release_notes.v3_43_0.3: Titles have more room, buttons are no longer covered, pages with images scroll evenly.
mod.release_notes.v3_43_0.4: These notes remain available under Help › About Glide.
mod.release_notes.v3_36_0.0: The home page and changed library cards update faster.
mod.release_notes.v3_36_0.1: Settings open faster and still discard unsaved input on Cancel.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_19.0: Faster: pages with many images, the home page and the settings window respond more quickly.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_19.1: Fewer writes per action – saving still happens immediately.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_20.0: Repeats: “Skip this occurrence” and “Skip missed occurrences” in the context menu.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_20.1: Reminders right when capturing: “remind 9 am” or “reminder 30 min before”.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_20.2: Pasting several lines into the input line creates one task per line if you wish.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_20.3: “+” creates, Shift+Enter opens the extended input; recently used lists and labels come first.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_20.4: Routines: recurring checklists optionally as a section of their own in “Today”.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_21.0: Light or dark like the system: Settings › Appearance & Controls.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_21.1: Narrow sidebar with icons: View › Narrow sidebar.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_21.2: The pinboard needs only one toolbar row; rarely used items are under “…”.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_21.3: Pages show their title large and a writing hint when empty.
mod.release_notes.v3_33_21.4: Calmer colours: purple only for Add, switched-on toggles neutral.
mod.release_notes.v3_34_0.0: Images in pages no longer overlap; printing and PDF include them.
mod.release_notes.v3_34_0.1: Markdown with images: copy, save and open again as a page.
mod.release_notes.v3_34_0.2: Search highlights matches in the open page.
mod.release_notes.v3_34_0.3: Saved filters explain why an item appears or is missing.
mod.release_notes.v3_34_0.4: Alt+Arrows also arrange pages, notes and drawings in the sidebar.
mod.release_notes.v3_35_0.0: An AI can revise existing tasks: send a context package, get a checked suggestion back.
mod.release_notes.v3_35_0.1: Comparing backups shows what changed between two states.
mod.release_notes.v3_35_0.2: Pixel workshop: change a colour with preview – double-click the colour bar.
mod.release_notes.v3_35_0.3: Before exporting a symbol, Glide shows 16, 32 and 48 pixels on light and dark backgrounds.

mod.release_notes.v1_0_3.1: A clean layered architecture separates application, Bento composition, and desktop shell.
mod.release_notes.v1_0_3.2: Enhanced reference integrity and consolidated product strategy for upcoming milestones.
